capabilities: Insert thread separators manually or automatically between paragraphs
Visualize fragment order and character size while typing
Attach images and media with accessibility descriptions from quote blocks
Send single posts or whole threads to the Mastodon server with size checks
Configure post size, language, visibility, quoting policy, and content warnings
extras: The author states it is a side project with no guaranteed responsiveness or maintenance. Credentials are stored encrypted via OAuth; the plugin never sees user passwords. Warns users to check their server's rules before posting whole threads publicly.
motivation: The README says making threads manually by pasting text and images is tedious, so the plugin uses Obsidian's editing to prepare snippets and send them automatically.
problem: Writing threads on Mastodon is tedious because posts must be manually split to fit size limits and pasted one by one with attachments.

relations.evidence: Thanks to Ryō Igarashi for maintaining the masto.js library.

summary: Compose Mastodon threads inside notes using separators, then post them or single posts to a Mastodon server with media and visibility settings.
